The electric windows for the front doors are operated through the switches on the driver's door (both windows) and the passenger side (passenger side only).

Both windows can only be operated with the ignition ON.

Operation is permitted for a further two minutes after the ignition has been switched from ON to OFF, but only if the doors are closed.

The electric windows circuit is protected by two special fuses, one for the driver's side and one for the passenger side and controlled by a specific relay, located in the junction unit under the dashboard.
